tasks.description: The intelligence layer should not become an unbounded inference engine. The graph (src/engine/graph.mjs) already holds claims with status (fact, theory, conjecture, contested, refuted) and provenance, promoted and demoted as evidence arrives. A finding is such a claim with source event links, affected entities, scope and time context and confidence, whose evidence-derived status is capped at theory; fact needs a person's event or a verification record; ordinary claims keep today's rule. Conflict detection, precision and recall and decision routing are SO-F-13. Definitions accepted 1 Nov 2026: (1) A stub session is an agent subject or a raw status op: neither can promote a finding to fact, by a logged status change, an adjudication, a verification or evidence. (2) A verification record may be written by a person, operator or service subject; it takes effect only when its result is a pass, and a record from an agent or with a failed result is kept and changes nothing. (3) The 'by' field of an event is set from the resolved credential (SO-F-01), never from caller input: through the credential-bound entry point a caller-supplied 'by' is ignored, so a forged by of person:x on an adjudication or service:x on a verification makes no finding a fact, and an agent credential in the personal scope resolves to an agent subject, not to person:owner. (4) Withholding is strict: if any source of a finding is withheld from the reader, the whole statement is withheld, with the reasons and corrections in its history and every entity or owner drawn from a withheld source, and an entity or owner with no source (source null) is withheld from every partial view; the reader sees only how many sources are withheld. Provisional: who may adjudicate (a person), who may verify (a person, operator or service), who may dismiss (a person or an operator subject only, by the safe default of ADR 5 that what is ungated stays denied; an agent or a service subject cannot dismiss) and the two adjudication outcomes, confirm and reject, are provisional until the permission matrix (ADR 5, open, in docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md) and the decision and blocker workflow (SO-A-05) are decided; they are kept in one table so that deciding them changes one place.
